web-guide-idea-35.audience: Applicants who struggle to describe their actual experience.
web-guide-idea-35.offer: Help someone turn a confusing CV into a clearer account of their work. Keep claims truthful and focus on the role they are targeting.
web-guide-idea-35.steps.0: Ask for a redacted CV and target role.
web-guide-idea-35.steps.1: Review structure, evidence and wording together.
web-guide-idea-35.steps.2: Rewrite one section collaboratively and agree the next edits.
web-guide-idea-35.equipment: A phone for the call; a laptop is helpful for document editing. Avoid collecting unnecessary personal details.
web-guide-idea-35.returnReason: Offer a later review after revisions or for a different role, with a concrete scope each time.
web-guide-idea-35.promotion: Show an invented before-and-after bullet so people understand your approach without exposing a client’s CV.
